notes.title: A new Old School Musical DLC with mistermv is coming on June 25th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/d53aa7a5e09cf9d65449e99882e9452e01cacecb.jpg[/img]


After the DLC made in partnership with Toriena and the Switch and Mobile releases, Old School Musical is being expanded with one last DLC for the Chicken Republic Mode, with mistermv as the main musical featuring.

[b]Coming on June 25th on Steam & Switch[/b], this DLC is a [b]partnership with Xavier “mistermv” Dang[/b], a well known French streamer / youtuber. He’s also an amazing chiptune / electro musician who already composed video games soundtracks for various games, including Bokida & Crazy Frog Racer & released 10 EP albums.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/4e32163c2f16880cc728cbfba8c0c726591004c7.png[/img]


Like the Toriena DLC launched last November, this DLC will be completely free! If you’ve unlocked the Chicken Republic Mode, the new levels will be added at the end of the Chicken Republic levels.

This will also be the last DLC for Old School Musical (no more chickens after that), bringing  the number of tracks in the game to 60. We’re super proud of the final result, & we hope you’ll have as much fun playing it as we had making it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/82e7819015cd2f215720463f1f013757d08f6e1f.jpg[/img]


[u][b]What's coming : [/b][/u]

- Discover 5 new tracks and challenges
- Stroll through MV Expo, the world's greatest chicken convention! MV Expo is your chance to dive into the loony universe of the eldest French streamer
- Brace yourself for the new challenges of Chicken Republic and its new diabolic modifiers
 
See you on June 25th, don’t forget to save the date & tell your friends.

You can follow Old School Musical on [url=https://twitter.com/osmgame]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/oldschoolmusical/]Facebook[/url] & our publisher Dear Villagers on [url=https://twitter.com/DearVillagers]Twitter[/url] & [url=https://www.facebook.com/DearVillagers/]Facebook[/url] not to miss news about Old School Musical.

You can also follow mistermv on his Twitter accounts [url=https://twitter.com/mistermv]mistermv (Streamer)[/url] / [url=https://twitter.com/XavDang]Xavier Dang (Composer)[/url] & [url=https://www.twitch.tv/mistermv]Twitch[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31217741/24725ab32ce435641fdd8a7fb9551ba3128e2c07.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - Bug fixes, nerfs & a better Korean support
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/65cde3588f126dbf57afb61273d33bdff8fd7b11.png[/img]

Hi fellow pixel aficionados!

We're more than happy to see that you are more & more playing OSM & we've started [b]fixing issues[/b] you've told us on social media. But let's get to the point, here's the [b]patchlog[/b] of what changes in this [b]new version[/b]!

- Nerfed visual effects for Outrash Revenge (glitches are not violent anymore)
- Better Korean support (font improved and changes in localization)
- [STEAM] Fixed achievements "All Star Teacher" and "All Star Newbie"
- Various bug fixes

Updates will continue to come, to stay [b]up to date[/b] with the [b]latest news[/b] and [b]updates[/b] regarding [b]Old School Musical[/b], please [b]visit[/b] the [url=https://www.osmgame.com/][b]Official website[/b][/url], [b]like[/b] the official  [url=https://www.facebook.com/oldschoolmusical/][b]Facebook page[/b][/url] and [b]follow[/b] the game on [url=https://twitter.com/osmgame][b]Twitter[/b][/url].

And you can also [b]add[/b] the game to your [b]wishlist[/b] too!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/ae9abddd471fe04507c669938a0046b9527e493a.png[/img]

notes.title: Old School Musical is finally coming to PC & Nintendo Switch™ on September 13th!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/95938c52ea85e14571766bae0894ef0fc0e5d2b1.png[/img]

[b]Stay in (chip)tune with the music in wacky rhythm game Old School Musical![/b]

You thought you had seen everything in rhythm games? You are not ready for what’s coming! Discover our new [b]teaser[/b]:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Yvq0RvwpJ-w
Old School Musical is a [b]retro rhythm game[/b] with a unique [b]chiptune soundtrack[/b] that will send you back directly to the golden years of the [b]8-bit era[/b]. The main protagonists, Tib and Rob, have been trained to become video game heroes. One fateful day, their game gets corrupted by a [b]bug invasion[/b], thus pushing them to embark on an unlikely journey to [b]find their missing mother[/b] and [b]save our childhood games[/b]! Your skill, their success: miss notes and Tib and Rob's adventure will fall flat… Literally! 

Swing a crowbar, shoot with your spacecraft and defeat an evil chicken army to the beat of chiptune tracks from famous artists such as [b]Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko[/b] and [b]Le Plancton[/b]. Discover over [b]50 tracks[/b], composed exclusively for the game! The OST will be [b]available for purchase[/b] on Steam and other music platforms.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/ae9abddd471fe04507c669938a0046b9527e493a.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31217741/5573067b5a667c9e5346fba362b8032638841cde.png[/img]

Old School Musical unique features include:

- [b]Story Mode[/b]: Lead Tib and Rob in their crazy adventure filled with humor
- [b]Arcade Mode[/b]: Reach the highest score and challenge your friends (if you have any)
- [b]Challenge Mode[/b]: Play it hard with visual and audio penalties to unlock new music tracks
- [b]50+ chiptune tracks[/b] by the best of the chiptune scene: Dubmood, Zabutom, Hello World, Yponeko, Le Plancton
- Travel through [b]20+ retro levels[/b], inspired by our childhood games
- A [b]multiplayer mode[/b] with up to [b]4 players[/b]
- [b]Chickens[/b]

Old School Musical will be released on [b]Nintendo Switch™[/b] and [b]PC[/b] on [b]September 13 2018[/b] for [b]$12,99/12,99€[/b].
You can now [b]pre-order[/b] Old School Musical on the [b]Nintendo Switch™ eShop[/b] or add it to your [b]wishlist[/b] on [b]Steam[/b].

To stay up to date with the latest [b]news[/b] and [b]information[/b] regarding Old School Musical:
Please visit the official [url=https://www.osmgame.com/][b]website[/b][/url]
Like the official [url=https://www.facebook.com/oldschoolmusical/][b]Facebook[/b][/url] page
Follow the game on [url=https://twitter.com/OSMgame][b]Twitter[/b][/url].
